question.text: P and Q combines to form two compounds $\mathrm{PQ}_2$ and $\mathrm{PQ}_3$. If $1 \mathrm{~g} \mathrm{P} Q_2$ is dissolved in 51 g benzene the depression of freezing point becomes $0.8^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$. On the other hand if $1 \mathrm{~g} \mathrm{PQ}_3$ is dissolved in 51 g of benzene, the depression of freezing point becomes $0.625^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$. The atomic mass of $P$ and $Q$ are $\left(\mathrm{K}_{\mathrm{f}}\right.$ of benzene $\left.=5.1 \mathrm{~K} \mathrm{~kg} \mathrm{~mol}^{-1}\right)$
